test_list.description: Sequence numbers start at 1 and increase by 1; the record's own seq is ignored.
read_range(from, to) returns exactly the inclusive range, ordered.
append_batch writes all records in one transaction and returns the last seq; an empty batch changes nothing.
Closing and reopening keeps head and every record.
Opening the same file twice reports Locked (one owner per database).
A database under `dir with space/événements.redb` opens, appends and reads.
EventLog works through the sdk EventStore trait (as the bus uses it).
proptest: any sequence of events reads back identical and ordered.
